scp.Name: SCP: Secret Laboratory
scp.Description: Round-based multiplayer SCP game where players have different objectives depending on what team they spawn as. Server runs several custom plugins to make the rounds more interesting.
scp.Notes: Server won't show up in the browser. Join through Steam or use direct connect. DM OPGman for the IP.

sandbox.Name: Sandbox (Garry's Mod)
sandbox.Description: Runs the vanilla Sandbox gamemode with addons from community requests and other Lambda Gaming servers.
sandbox.Notes: Join through the legacy browser or direct connect if the server doesn't show up in the normal browser. DM OPGman for the IP.

various.Name: Various Gamemodes (Garry's Mod)
various.Description: This server currently hosts the following gamemodes: Cops and Runners, Darkest Days, Dropzone, Flood, The Hidden IRIS Edition, Jazztronauts, Prop Hunt Enhanced Plus, Pirate Ship Wars Remix, Sledbuild, Stop it Slender, TTT2, Trash Compactor, and Zombie Survival Classic.
various.Notes: Join through the legacy browser or direct connect if the server doesn't show up in the normal browser. DM OPGman for the IP.

vanilla.Name: Minecraft Vanilla
vanilla.Description: Always runs the most recent release of the game without any mods. New saves are created for almost every major update.
vanilla.Notes: Player slots are limited so veteran members have priority. DM OPGman for the IP.

modded.Name: Minecraft Modded
modded.Description: Mostly vanilla-friendly modpack with a focus on magic, exploration, and building. Runs over 200 mods on version 1.21.1 with NeoForge.
modded.Notes: Player slots are limited so veteran members have priority. DM OPGman for the IP.

unbalanced.Name: Minecraft Unbalanced
unbalanced.Description: Challenging modpack that involves building up high-tech infrastructure to defeat powerful enemies in a post-apocalyptic world. Runs around 50 mods on version 1.7.10 with Forge.
unbalanced.Notes: Player slots are limited so veteran members have priority. DM OPGman for the IP.

hl2dm.Name: Half-Life 2 Deathmatch
hl2dm.Description: Classic toilet throwing. Runs vanilla maps only.

tf2.Name: Team Fortress 2
tf2.Description: Hat simulator with Freak Fortress installed as an optional gamemode.
tf2.Notes: The content linked below is only for Freak Fortress. The server might be password protected. DM OPGman for the password and IP.

kf2.Name: Killing Floor 2
kf2.Description: Zombie FPS. Runs a few custom maps.
kf2.Notes: Server might be password protected. DM OPGman for the password and IP.

hldm.Name: Half-Life Deathmatch
hldm.Description: Runs a massive collection of maps with a randomized cycle.

hlurp.Name: Half-Life Universe RP (Garry's Mod)
hlurp.Description: Custom roleplay gamemode based on the major events of the official Half-Life games.
hlurp.Notes: Join through the legacy browser or direct connect if the server doesn't show up in the normal browser. DM OPGman for the IP.

cityrp.Name: CityRP (Garry's Mod)
cityrp.Description: More advanced and realistic version of DarkRP, with a big focus on player freedom.
cityrp.Notes: Join through the legacy browser or direct connect if the server doesn't show up in the normal browser. DM OPGman for the IP.
